model_annotation: The plot illustrates the trends of Wirtschafts politik insgesamt (total economics), Finanzpolitik (financial policy), and Handelspolitik (trade policy) over time. The x-axis represents the year from 2016 to 2024, with a linear scale and tick labels spaced every one year. The y-axis ranges from 0 to 1000, with units of percentage points, and the tick labels are spaced in increments of 100. A solid black line represents Wirtschafts politik insgesamt, starting at approximately 1000 in 2016 and decreasing to approximately 800 in 2020, followed by a gradual increase to approximately 950 in 2024. A dashed blue line represents Finanzpolitik, beginning at approximately 800 in 2016, fluctuating between approximately 700 and 200 in the years 2018-2020, and then increasing to approximately 1200 in 2024. Finally, a gray line represents Handelspolitik, starting at approximately 700 in 2016, fluctuating between approximately 600 and 400 in the years 2018-2020, and then increasing to approximately 800 in 2024.
